answer: The lagoon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the gale of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the delta re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
